messages:
nate: quick sync / decision needed on the "microdump" capture prototype. do we ship a tenant-safe default or require opt-in for all tenants?
eli: i'd prefer a safe default: 0.5% sampling, tenant-hash bucketing, default scrub = "strict-v2". opt-in for relaxed.
reena: agree on conservative default. question: how do we enforce quota and visibility? teams keep turning on captures and costs balloon.
anna: proposal: two limits = daily token budget per tenant + rolling minute burst tokens. console shows remaining budget and expected cost delta if you enable. disable capture automatically when budget reaches 0.
nate: if disabled, do we keep sampling as fallback (like 1-in-10000) for debug continuity or stop entirely?
eli: keep a trace-level fallback sample (1-in-100k) and emit a reason tag (quota_exhausted) in the trace. that keeps provenance.
reena: scrub strategy: don't rely on regex-only. route raw microdumps to dedicated scrubbers (cpu-constrained pool) for NLP-based PII redact, then write redacted artifact to long-term store. keep encrypted pre-scrub for 30 minutes only.
anna: UX: console should display per-route profile, last-redacted-sample ts, number of unredacted views, and a quick-mode toggle for auditors that requires 2FA + owner approval.
ops-bot: deploy: microdump.v0 canary -> 5% hosts. metric emitted: microdump.capture.attempt and microdump.scrub.latency_ms.
eli: require scrub profiles-as-code. sample schema: 
```
profiles:
  strict-v2:
    detectors: [nlp-person, regex-email, regex-phone]
    keep_context_tokens: 0
  analytics-lite:
    detectors: [nlp-person]
    keep_context_tokens: 64
```
teams select profile per route via route config. default = strict-v2.
reena: enforce a linter that forbids profiles that set detectors=[] for prod routes. i'll add that to the infra repo.
anna: breakglass flow: two-person approval via console + signed audit entry. every unredacted export must be KMS-wrapped and TTLed. show viewer identity and reason in audit log.
nate: routing question: scrubber pool vs inline scrubbers in existing service. scrubber pool means extra hop and cost but better isolation. inline is lower latency but bigger blast radius. votes?
eli: scrubber pool. we already have async pipelines for embed-ingest. reuse that pattern. keep pre-scrub store encrypted for 30m.
reena: agree. also add a cost-guard: auto-disable if projected monthly microdump spend > 5% tenant bill or > $2k/month absolute. raise a console alert and email tenant contacts.
anna: telemetry: expose microdump.capture.rate, scrub-success-rate, avg-PII-detections-per-sample, and cost-estimate per day. add console line item in billing preview.
nate: ok next steps: reena to PR scrub-profile linter, eli to draft RFC for quotas/fallback, anna to add console mocks + breakglass UI, ops to run canary and watch microdump.scrub.latency_ms.
reena: i'll also put a small e2e to verify that unredacted artifacts are never persisted beyond TTL.
ops-bot: note: canary booting on hosts: canary-13. watchlist created: microdump.scrub.latency_ms > 5s -> page oncall.
eli: timeline: RFC by Wed EOD, console mock by next Mon, linter PR within 3 days. :thumbsup:
nate: thanks y'all. filing followups in doc: https://go/r/microdump-policy
